# Lifecycle emails (generated by emails/build.mjs, site https://eventcheckin-five.vercel.app)

| File | Subject | Send when |
|---|---|---|
| `01-welcome.html` | Welcome to EventCheckin, {{FIRST_NAME}} | Immediately after sign-up (contact added to the "EventCheckin organisers" list) |
| `02-no-event-day-1.html` | Set up your first event in 2 minutes | 1 day after sign-up, only if the organiser has not created an event |
| `03-no-event-day-3.html` | Want a hand with your first event? | 3 days after sign-up, only if the organiser still has not created an event |
| `05-event-created.html` | {{EVENT_NAME}} is ready. Now add your guests | When the organiser creates their first event |
| `10-day-before-event.html` | Tomorrow: your check-in checklist for {{EVENT_NAME}} | 1 day before the event date |
| `11-event-recap.html` | {{EVENT_NAME}} in numbers | The day after the event date |
